summary.text: Alan Jimenez is the Democratic candidate for the Utah House of Representatives, District 61, in the November 3, 2026 general election, against incumbent Republican Lisa Shepherd and Constitution Party candidate Jennifer Doud.
Jimenez works in information technology and, in a Ballotpedia survey, described himself as a cybersecurity professional and lifelong Utah County resident.

paragraphs.text: Jimenez earned a high school diploma from Mountain View High School and a graduate degree from Western Governors University in 2024.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is the son of immigrants from Peru and Spain.
Jimenez listed lower costs and responsible growth, strong schools and local opportunity, and accountable representation as his key messages.
He said he is passionate about housing affordability, public education and transparent government, and listed 314 Action and the Women's Democratic Club of Utah as endorsers.
